headline: SAP Vendor Master Data Specialist | Data Governance · Procure-to-Pay · SAP MM/FI | Payment Fraud Prevention & SOX Controls | Automation: Power Automate · VBA · SAP GUI Scripting

experience.title: SAP Master Data Specialist (Vendor Master & P2P)
experience.description: Own vendor master data governance for 1,500+ active suppliers across NA, EMEA, and APAC in SAP ECC (MM/FI). Prevented USD 4M+ in fraudulent payment exposure by detecting bank-account substitution schemes. Zero audit findings on owned SOX controls. Cut manual tracking ~15% by migrating vendor-setup requests to SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power Automate. Automated vendor creations/changes with SAP GUI scripting, Excel VBA, and Winshuttle. Partnered with PwC on spin-off separation (new legal-entity vendor setup, vendor data split, supply-chain-risk vendor blocking). Cross-trained a Customer Master analyst on vendor master processes. Supported ADI Europe vendor maintenance requests through the post-spin-off transition and the system audit for the vendor maintenance area.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
experience.description: Replaced a whiteboard-only maintenance tracking process with an Excel VBA tool I built, adopted as the team's standard. Maintained sales and performance databases in Excel for management reporting. Implemented a document filing and records-management system.

experience.title: Accounting Analyst
experience.description: Processed vendor invoices in an Oracle-based ERP using 3-way match. Performed account reconciliations and data cleansing. Supported tax information reporting.

experience.title: Collections Agent
experience.description: Earned monthly performance bonus six consecutive months by exceeding collections KPIs. Performed QA reviews on peers' calls. Liaison with GSB shared services.
